name: zimage_init_texture_directory
description: zImage::InitTextureDirectory clears the texture-directory table and creates the default texture record for hardware renderer paths.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zImage texture-directory/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x46d550 validates the texture-directory count reset, 0x24000-byte table clear, hardware-renderer guard, default texture-name pointer, default image pointer, zeroed creation arguments, and return value.
The native smoke verifies both software-renderer skip behavior and hardware-renderer default texture-record creation/storage.
